name: Ayaan
homeIntro: Hey guys, I'm Ayaan — welcome to my little corner of the internet where I log the trails I hike and the places I travel. Pull up a chair and explore.
bio: I'm Ayaan, currently studying Mechanical Engineering at the University of Hong Kong. My biggest dream is to become a pilot — and the absolute goal is to do both: work as an aerospace engineer while flying as a pilot. Outside of that, I want to travel to every corner of the world, stay as fit as I possibly can, and keep playing the sport I love. This site is where I keep track of the hikes and trips along the way.
footerBio: A hobby blog for my hikes and travels. Aspiring pilot and aerospace engineer, forever planning the next trip.
